Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -54.14% and on 'SELL' status. SPAL, a new leveraged position, is also deeply underwater at -56.5%. Both leveraged ETFs carry significant decay risk, amplified by your margin. SMH (-14.29%) and QQQI (-4.56%) are on 'TRIM' status and nearing their stops.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) for further decay and stop breaches. Also, monitor SMH and QQQI as they approach their trim stops.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged positions aggressively and respect your stops, even as Big Tech shows strength.
plays: Cut SOXL given its deep -54.14% loss and 'SELL' status; leveraged ETFs decay fast, especially on margin.
